description: Reviewed boundary, rich-inline, shared complex-walker, leading-ZWSP, exclamation-break, figure-space glue, pair-table gap, CJK closing-bracket, Safari line-edge kerning, WebKit engine routing, segment-break removal and Blink soft-hyphen retreat fixes, then each browser's own line breaker: ports of Blink's, WebKit's and Gecko's scans over their own tables. The runner measures this source and every candidate against the same fresh browser observations; existing mismatches remain observations, never expected answers.
